assumptions: 20-card deck; target species with c copies, m other Basic Pokemon cards, p Poke Ball, r Professor's Research, cc Copycat; every other card is inert for turn 1.
Opening hand follows deckgym-core: 1 uniformly random Basic card + 4 uniformly from the other 19 cards; no mulligans.
Both players draw 1 card at the start of their first turn (deckgym-core queues a draw for the first player on turn 1 as well).
Mirror match: the opponent plays the same deck and policy. Copycat draws as many cards as the opponent's hand at that moment, so cc > 0 values depend on this assumption.
inPlay counts the target as Active or Benched at the end of the player's own first turn (turn 1 going first, turn 2 going second). Bench limit 3.
Fossils are not Basic Pokemon in the engine and are not counted in m.
Tools (t) are not a key: values are the t = 0 cells. Own Tools played before Copycat add only +0.1..+0.3 pp (see METHODS.md); look up any deck by ignoring t.
